public_intel.text: An alarm was reported at Dispatch yard (D), while Hill clinic (F) sent an interrupted request for help. No inside-shelter check accompanied either report. Both supply depots are west of road D-E.

The archived 09:16 alarm at Dispatch yard (D) was a scheduled equipment test. Hill clinic's (F) original request contains no diagnosis. The alarm correction alone does not establish any shelter's current condition.

A recovered pre-mission inventory confirms that Service junction (E), Hill clinic (F), Terrace shelter (G), and East hall (H) held no local supply stock. This report adds no supplies and does not reveal current exposure.

ground_truth_timeline.text: Hill clinic (F) is the only initially exposed shelter. Both depots are initially safe and each has three supply units.
The Dispatch yard alarm was unrelated to exposure. Road D-E is the only connection from either depot to the eastern shelters. The reports never create additional infection or supply events.
